name: 4594-batchdecode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16, ~8.03B params (~16.1 GB).
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=256, bounded at 10240 requests / 1800 s safety, with the first 10% and last 10% discarded by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, prompt exactly 256 tokens and output exactly 256 tokens (min = max on both), `request_format: plain` so no chat template is applied, `ignore_eos` true, temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, n=1, no beam search, static seed 4594.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant generating 256-token replies to 256-token prompts for 256 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine is commit cc466a32903d53d0ceca459b766d74ad668c8f87 (`git describe --tags` gives
# v0.4.2-12-gcc466a3290), a source checkout; the interpreter is named by env.yaml `venv:`.
# This is a May-2024 argument set: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, so do
# not add keys from a later vLLM (no V1 settings, no compilation-config, no async-scheduling).

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 256
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
block-size: 16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
enforce-eager: false
max-model-len: 2048

# Left at false, i.e. logging ON, on purpose: the engine's own periodic line reports the running
# batch, which must sit near the 256 concurrent streams scenario.json declares. A run whose batch
# sat well below that operated a different setup, and the log is the only place it is visible.
disable-log-stats: false
